subtopics.title: Algorithms and Programming (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: The student will design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including loops and conditionals.
The student will investigate variables and data types, including simple operations on strings.
The student will implement a program that accepts input values, stores them in appropriately named variables, and produces output.
The student will document programs in order to make them easier to trace, test, and debug.

subtopics.title: Algorithms and Programming (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: The student will use flowcharts and/or pseudo code to address complex problems as algorithms.
The student will incorporate existing code, media, and libraries into original programs, and give attribution.
The student will systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.

subtopics.title: Break problems into component parts, extract key information, and develop descriptive models, using technologies when appropriate, to understand complex systems or facilitate problem-solving

outcomes.text: Students break down problems into smaller parts, identify key information, and propose solutions using technologies, when appropriate.

subtopics.title: Understand how automation works and use algorithmic thinking to develop a sequence of steps to create and test automated solutions

outcomes.text: Students explore and understand basic concepts related to automation, patterns, and algorithmic thinking.

topics.title: Students communicate clearly and express themselves creatively for a variety of purposes using appropriate technologies (including assistive technologies), styles, formats, and digital media appropriate to their goals

subtopics.title: Choose the appropriate technologies and resources for meeting the desired objectives of their creation or communication

outcomes.text: Students recognize, select, and use the features and functions of a variety of appropriate creation and communication technologies to create products or communicate with others.

subtopics.title: Create original works or responsibly repurpose or remix digital resources into new creations

outcomes.text: Students use appropriate technologies to create original works and learn strategies for remixing other digital works to create new digital works.

subtopics.title: Communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively by creating or using a variety of digital objects such as visualizations, models, or simulations

outcomes.text: Students create digital works to communicate ideas visually and graphically.

subtopics.title: Publish or present content that customizes the message and medium for the intended audiences

outcomes.text: Students select and use appropriate technologies to design and publish content while considering the audience when creating digital works and presentations.

topics.title: Students use appropriate technologies, including assistive technologies, to broaden their perspectives and enrich their learning by collaborating with others and working effectively in teams locally and globally

subtopics.title: Use appropriate technologies to connect with learners from a variety of backgrounds and cultures, engaging with them in ways that broaden mutual understanding and learning

outcomes.text: Students use appropriate technologies to connect with a digital community that includes different backgrounds and cultures.

subtopics.title: Use collaborative technologies to work with others, including peers, experts, and community members to examine issues and problems from multiple viewpoints

outcomes.text: Students use collaborative technologies to work with others, including peers, experts, and online community members to learn the perspective of others.

subtopics.title: Contribute constructively to project teams, assuming various roles and responsibilities to work effectively toward a common goal

outcomes.text: Students take on a variety of assigned team roles and use appropriate technologies to complete a project and work toward a common goal.

subtopics.title: Explore local and global issues and use collaborative technologies to work with others to investigate solutions

outcomes.text: Students use collaborative technologies to work with others to understand problems and investigate solutions to local and global issues.
